title: Company Name on Cover Page
description: The cover page of the DRHP must prominently display the full legal name of the issuer company.
validation_question: Is the full legal name of the issuer company displayed on the cover page?
what_to_look_for: Company name ending with 'Limited' or 'Private Limited' on the first page.
common_violations: Company name missing or abbreviated

title: Corporate Identity Number (CIN) Disclosure
description: The DRHP must disclose the Corporate Identity Number (CIN) of the issuer company on the cover page or general information section.
validation_question: Is the Corporate Identity Number (CIN) of the company disclosed?
what_to_look_for: A 21-digit alphanumeric code starting with L or U (e.g., L21000MH2020PLC123456).
common_violations: CIN missing or incorrect format

title: Registered Office Address
description: The registered office address including city, state, and PIN code must be disclosed on the cover page.
validation_question: Is the full registered office address disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Complete address with city, state, PIN code on the cover or general information section.
common_violations: Incomplete address or missing PIN code

title: Risk Factors Reference on Cover Page
description: The cover page must contain a specific reference directing investors to the Risk Factors section with page numbers.
validation_question: Does the cover page contain a clear reference directing readers to the Risk Factors section?
what_to_look_for: A statement on the first few pages like 'For risk factors, see page XX' or 'Investors should refer to Risk Factors beginning on page XX'.
common_violations: No reference to risk factors on cover page

title: Book Running Lead Managers (BRLMs) Details
description: The cover page must list all Book Running Lead Managers (BRLMs) with their names and SEBI registration numbers.
validation_question: Are the Book Running Lead Managers listed with their SEBI registration numbers?
what_to_look_for: Names of investment banks/merchant bankers with SEBI registration numbers (INM format).
common_violations: BRLM details missing or SEBI registration number not provided

title: Registrar to the Offer Details
description: The cover page must list the Registrar to the Offer with contact details and SEBI registration number.
validation_question: Is the Registrar to the Offer listed with SEBI registration and contact details?
what_to_look_for: Registrar name, address, phone, email, website, and SEBI registration number.
common_violations: Registrar details incomplete or missing

title: Issue Type and Size Disclosure
description: The cover page must clearly state whether it is a Fresh Issue or Offer for Sale (OFS) or a combination, along with the issue size.
validation_question: Does the cover page clearly state the type of issue (Fresh Issue/OFS) and the total issue size?
what_to_look_for: Statement specifying 'Fresh Issue of X equity shares' and/or 'Offer for Sale of Y equity shares by selling shareholders' with aggregate amounts.
common_violations: Issue type not clearly specified or size missing

title: Price Band and Face Value Disclosure
description: The face value of equity shares and the price band (or fixed price) must be disclosed on the cover page.
validation_question: Are the face value and price band/issue price clearly disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Statement like 'Face value Rs. 10 per equity share' and 'Price band: Rs. X to Rs. Y per equity share'.
common_violations: Face value or price band not mentioned on cover page

title: DRHP/RHP Document Type Label
description: The document must be clearly labeled as 'Draft Red Herring Prospectus' (DRHP) or 'Red Herring Prospectus' (RHP).
validation_question: Is the document clearly labeled as DRHP or RHP?
what_to_look_for: The words 'DRAFT RED HERRING PROSPECTUS' or 'RED HERRING PROSPECTUS' prominently on the cover page.
common_violations: Document type label missing or unclear

title: Filing Date with ROC/SEBI
description: The date of filing with SEBI and/or Registrar of Companies (ROC) must be mentioned.
validation_question: Is the filing date with SEBI/ROC disclosed?
what_to_look_for: A date on the cover page indicating when the document was filed.
common_violations: Filing date missing

title: Risk Factors Section Present
description: The DRHP must contain a dedicated Risk Factors section disclosing all material risks to the business, operations, and investment.
validation_question: Does the DRHP contain a dedicated Risk Factors section?
what_to_look_for: A clearly titled 'RISK FACTORS' section in the document with a list of identified risks.
common_violations: Risk Factors section missing entirely

title: Internal vs External Risk Classification
description: Risk factors must be categorized into internal risks (company/industry specific) and external risks (macro/regulatory).
validation_question: Are the risk factors clearly categorized into internal and external risks?
what_to_look_for: Distinct sub-sections or headings for 'Internal Risks' and 'External Risks' within the Risk Factors section.
common_violations: No clear categorization of internal vs external risks

title: Risk Factors Ordered by Materiality
description: Risk factors shall be listed in order of materiality, with the most significant risks appearing first.
validation_question: Are risk factors organized in order of materiality with the most significant risks listed first?
what_to_look_for: The first few risk factors should address the most critical business-specific risks, not generic market risks.
common_violations: Generic risks listed before company-specific material risks

title: Risk Factors Quantification
description: Where possible, risk factors should be quantified with financial impact figures.
validation_question: Are risk factors quantified with financial impact figures where applicable?
what_to_look_for: Monetary figures (₹, crore, lakh) within risk factor descriptions indicating financial exposure.
common_violations: Risk factors described qualitatively without quantification of potential impact

title: Risk Mitigation Measures
description: The company should describe measures taken or proposed to mitigate material risks.
validation_question: Does the document describe risk mitigation measures for material risks?
what_to_look_for: Statements about steps taken to address risks, insurance coverage, hedging strategies, or risk management frameworks.
common_violations: Risks listed without any discussion of mitigation measures

title: Capital Structure Section Present
description: The DRHP must contain a Capital Structure section showing authorized, issued, subscribed, and paid-up share capital.
validation_question: Is the capital structure disclosed with authorized, issued, subscribed, and paid-up share capital?
what_to_look_for: A table showing different categories of share capital with face values and amounts.
common_violations: Capital structure table missing or incomplete

title: Shareholding Pattern Table
description: Pre-issue and post-issue shareholding pattern must be disclosed with promoter, public, and institutional holdings.
validation_question: Is the pre-issue and post-issue shareholding pattern disclosed in tabular form?
what_to_look_for: Tables showing promoter/public shareholding before and after the IPO with number of shares and percentages.
common_violations: Missing post-issue shareholding or percentage calculations

title: History of Share Capital Changes
description: The history of share capital increases and changes including bonus issues, splits, and rights issues must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the history of share capital changes and allotments disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Chronological table of share allotments showing date, number of shares, issue price, and reason for allotment.
common_violations: Incomplete share allotment history

title: Employee Stock Options (ESOP) Details
description: If the company has an ESOP scheme, full details including vesting schedule, exercise price, and total options must be disclosed.
validation_question: If ESOP/ESOS schemes exist, are their details including vesting schedule and exercise price disclosed?
what_to_look_for: ESOP scheme details with grant date, vesting period, exercise price, and number of options outstanding.
common_violations: ESOP details incomplete or dilution impact not quantified

title: Objects of the Issue Clearly Stated
description: The objects of the issue must clearly specify what the IPO proceeds will be used for.
validation_question: Are the objects of the issue clearly specified with intended utilization of proceeds?
what_to_look_for: A section titled 'Objects of the Offer/Issue' with specific details on how IPO proceeds will be used.
common_violations: Vague or overly general objects without specific fund deployment details

title: Means of Finance Disclosure
description: The means of financing each object must be disclosed, including the contribution from IPO proceeds and other sources.
validation_question: Are the means of finance for each object disclosed with sources clearly identified?
what_to_look_for: Table showing total project cost, IPO proceeds contribution, and other funding sources (internal accruals, bank loans).
common_violations: No clear breakdown of funding sources for project costs

title: Schedule of Deployment
description: A detailed schedule of deployment of funds must be provided showing expected utilization timeline.
validation_question: Is a schedule of deployment of funds provided with timeline?
what_to_look_for: Table showing year-wise or quarter-wise planned deployment of IPO proceeds across different objects.
common_violations: Missing deployment schedule or vague timelines

title: Monitoring Agency Appointment
description: If the issue size exceeds Rs. 100 crore, a monitoring agency must be appointed to report on fund utilization.
validation_question: If the issue exceeds Rs. 100 crore, has a monitoring agency been appointed?
what_to_look_for: Name and details of the monitoring agency, or a statement that issue size is below the threshold.
common_violations: Monitoring agency not appointed for large issues

title: General Corporate Purpose Cap (25%)
description: Amount earmarked for general corporate purposes shall not exceed 25% of the total amount raised.
validation_question: Is the amount allocated to General Corporate Purposes within the 25% cap?
what_to_look_for: The percentage or amount earmarked for 'General Corporate Purposes' should be ≤25% of the total issue size.
common_violations: General corporate purpose allocation exceeds 25% without proper justification

title: Basis for Offer Price Section Present
description: The DRHP must contain a Basis for Offer Price section with quantitative and qualitative justification.
validation_question: Does the DRHP contain a Basis for Offer Price section?
what_to_look_for: A clearly titled section explaining the rationale for the offer price.
common_violations: Basis for Offer Price section missing

title: EPS Disclosure in Basis for Price
description: Earnings Per Share (EPS) — basic and diluted — for the last three financial years must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the EPS (basic and diluted) for the last three years disclosed in the Basis for Offer Price section?
what_to_look_for: Table showing basic and diluted EPS for at least three financial years.
common_violations: EPS figures not provided or only for one year

title: P/E Ratio Disclosure
description: The Price to Earnings (P/E) ratio at the offer price must be disclosed and compared with industry peers.
validation_question: Is the P/E ratio at the offer price disclosed with industry peer comparison?
what_to_look_for: P/E ratio calculation at floor and cap price, compared with listed peers in the same industry.
common_violations: P/E ratio not calculated or peer comparison missing

title: Return on Net Worth (RoNW) Disclosure
description: Return on Net Worth (RoNW) for the last three financial years must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the RoNW/ROE for the last three years disclosed?
what_to_look_for: RoNW percentages for at least three financial years in the Basis for Offer Price section.
common_violations: RoNW not disclosed or calculation methodology not explained

title: Net Asset Value (NAV) Disclosure
description: Net Asset Value (NAV) per share before and after the issue must be disclosed.
search_keywords: net asset value per equity share
validation_question: Is the NAV per share (pre and post issue) disclosed?
what_to_look_for: NAV per share figures before and after the proposed issue.
common_violations: NAV per share not calculated or only pre-issue NAV shown

title: Peer Comparison Table
description: A comparison with listed industry peers showing key financial parameters (EPS, P/E, RoNW, revenue) must be provided.
validation_question: Is a peer comparison table with listed industry peers provided?
what_to_look_for: Table comparing the issuer's financial metrics with 3-5 listed peer companies.
common_violations: No peer comparison or irrelevant peers selected

title: Statement of Tax Benefits Present
description: A statement of possible tax benefits available to the company and its shareholders must be included.
validation_question: Does the DRHP include a Statement of Tax Benefits?
what_to_look_for: A section titled 'Statement of Tax Benefits' or 'Statement of Possible Tax Benefits'.
common_violations: Tax benefits section missing entirely

title: Tax Benefits Certified by Auditor
description: The statement of tax benefits must be certified by the statutory auditor or an independent chartered accountant.
validation_question: Is the statement of tax benefits certified by a qualified auditor/CA?
what_to_look_for: Certification statement by the statutory auditor or an independent CA at the end of the tax benefits section.
common_violations: Tax benefits not certified by an independent auditor

title: Industry Overview Section Present
description: The DRHP must contain an industry overview section describing the industry in which the company operates.
validation_question: Does the DRHP contain an Industry Overview section?
what_to_look_for: A section describing the industry, market size, growth trends, and competitive landscape.
common_violations: Industry overview section missing or too brief

title: Independent Industry Report Source
description: Industry data and statistics should be sourced from independent third-party reports with proper attribution.
validation_question: Are industry statistics sourced from independent third-party reports?
what_to_look_for: References to independent research firms or commissioned industry reports (e.g., CRISIL, Frost & Sullivan).
common_violations: Industry data without independent source attribution

title: Our Business Section Present
description: A comprehensive description of the company's business operations, products/services, and revenue model must be provided.
validation_question: Does the DRHP contain a comprehensive Our Business section?
what_to_look_for: A detailed section covering business model, products/services, customers, geography, and competitive advantages.
common_violations: Business description too brief or lacking specifics

title: Competitive Strengths Disclosure
description: The company must disclose its competitive strengths and key differentiators.
validation_question: Are the company's competitive strengths and differentiators disclosed?
what_to_look_for: A subsection listing specific competitive advantages with supporting evidence.
common_violations: Generic or unsupported competitive strength claims

title: Business Strategy Disclosure
description: The company's business strategy and future plans must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the company's business strategy and future plans disclosed?
what_to_look_for: A subsection outlining specific growth strategies with concrete plans.
common_violations: Strategy section missing or contains only aspirational statements

title: Key Regulations and Licenses
description: Key government approvals, licenses, and regulatory requirements for the business must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are key government approvals, licenses, and regulatory requirements disclosed?
what_to_look_for: A section listing material licenses, permits, and regulatory approvals required for business operations.
common_violations: Missing key regulatory licenses or expired permits not disclosed

title: Revenue Breakdown by Segment/Geography
description: Revenue breakdown by business segment and/or geography should be disclosed.
validation_question: Is a revenue breakdown by segment or geography provided?
what_to_look_for: Tables showing revenue contribution from different products, services, or geographic regions.
common_violations: No segmental revenue breakdown provided

title: Board of Directors Details
description: Full details of all directors including name, designation, DIN, address, age, and nationality must be provided.
validation_question: Are full details of all directors (name, DIN, designation, age) disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Table listing all directors with DIN, designation (Executive/Non-Executive/Independent), age, and date of appointment.
common_violations: DIN numbers missing or director profiles incomplete

title: Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) Details
description: Details of Key Managerial Personnel including CEO, CFO, Company Secretary, and other senior management must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are details of all Key Managerial Personnel disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Profiles of CEO, CFO, Company Secretary with qualifications, experience, and compensation.
common_violations: KMP details incomplete or compensation not disclosed

title: Director Qualifications and Experience
description: Educational qualifications, professional experience, and brief profiles of all directors must be provided.
validation_question: Are the qualifications and professional experience of all directors disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Individual director profiles with educational background, professional experience, and other directorships.
common_violations: Director profiles lacking qualification details or experience history

title: Director and KMP Compensation
description: Compensation details of directors and KMPs including salary, benefits, and stock options must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are compensation details for directors and KMPs disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Tables showing compensation breakdown for each director and KMP for the last year.
common_violations: Compensation details not itemized or total compensation not disclosed

title: Interest of Directors
description: Any interest of directors in the company (shareholding, transactions, property) must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are the interests of directors in the company disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Section disclosing directors' shareholding, property interests, and business transactions with the company.
common_violations: Director interests in related entities not fully disclosed

title: Corporate Governance Statement
description: The company must state compliance with corporate governance norms and describe its governance structure.
validation_question: Does the document include a corporate governance compliance statement?
what_to_look_for: A statement confirming the company's compliance with or plan to comply with SEBI LODR corporate governance requirements.
common_violations: No corporate governance compliance statement

title: Audit Committee Composition
description: The audit committee must consist of at least three directors with two-thirds being independent, and the chairperson must be an independent director.
validation_question: Is the Audit Committee properly constituted with at least 3 members and two-thirds independent directors?
what_to_look_for: Audit Committee members listed with their designations (Independent/Non-Executive) and a financial literate chairperson.
common_violations: Fewer than two-thirds independent directors or non-independent chairperson

title: Nomination and Remuneration Committee
description: A Nomination and Remuneration Committee with at least three non-executive directors, majority being independent, must be constituted.
validation_question: Is the Nomination and Remuneration Committee properly constituted?
what_to_look_for: NRC composition with at least 3 non-executive directors, majority independent.
common_violations: NRC not constituted or composition doesn't meet requirements

title: Stakeholders Relationship Committee
description: A Stakeholders Relationship Committee must be constituted to address investor grievances.
validation_question: Is a Stakeholders Relationship Committee constituted and disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Committee composition, terms of reference, and details of investor complaint handling mechanism.
common_violations: Stakeholders Relationship Committee not constituted

title: Risk Management Committee
description: For top 1000 listed entities by market cap, a Risk Management Committee must be constituted.
validation_question: Is a Risk Management Committee disclosed (if applicable)?
what_to_look_for: Committee composition and risk management policy disclosure.
common_violations: Risk Management Committee not disclosed where applicable

title: Promoter Identification and Details
description: All promoters must be identified with full personal details including name, age, PAN, passport, voter ID, and driving license numbers.
validation_question: Are all promoters identified with personal details and identification numbers?
what_to_look_for: Promoter profiles with name, age, nationality, PAN, and other ID numbers.
common_violations: Promoter identification details incomplete

title: Promoter Qualifications and Experience
description: Educational qualifications and professional experience of all promoters must be provided.
validation_question: Are the qualifications and experience of all promoters disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Detailed biographies of promoters covering education, work history, and expertise.
common_violations: Missing educational qualifications or vague experience descriptions

title: Promoter Group Entities
description: Details of all promoter group companies and entities must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are all promoter group companies and entities disclosed?
what_to_look_for: List of companies in the promoter group with CIN, business description, and financial highlights.
common_violations: Incomplete promoter group company details

title: Promoter Contribution and Lock-in
description: Minimum promoter contribution (at least 20% of post-issue capital) and lock-in period (3 years for minimum contribution, 1 year for excess) must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the minimum promoter contribution (20%) and lock-in period disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Statement showing promoter's post-issue holding ≥20% with 3-year lock-in on minimum contribution.
common_violations: Lock-in period details missing or promoter contribution below 20%

title: Disqualification of Promoters under Sec 164(2)
description: Confirmation that no promoter or director is disqualified under Section 164(2) of Companies Act.
validation_question: Is there a confirmation that no promoter/director is disqualified under Section 164(2)?
what_to_look_for: Explicit statement confirming no promoter or director is disqualified from acting as such.
common_violations: Missing confirmation of non-disqualification

title: Related Party Transactions Disclosure
description: All related party transactions must be disclosed with nature, parties, and amounts.
validation_question: Are all related party transactions disclosed with details?
what_to_look_for: Table listing related party transactions with party name, nature of transaction, and amount for last 3 years.
common_violations: Incomplete RPT disclosure or transactions not at arm's length

title: Related Party Transaction Policy
description: The company must have a Board-approved policy on related party transactions.
validation_question: Is a related party transaction policy disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Reference to a Board-approved RPT policy with criteria for approval and arm's length pricing.
common_violations: RPT policy not adopted or not disclosed

title: Dividend Policy Section Present
description: The DRHP must contain a Dividend Policy section.
validation_question: Does the DRHP contain a Dividend Policy section?
what_to_look_for: A section titled 'Dividend Policy' describing the company's approach to dividends.
common_violations: Dividend Policy section missing

title: Dividend History (Last 3 Years)
description: The company must disclose its dividend history for the last three financial years.
validation_question: Is the dividend history for the last three years disclosed (including nil declaration if applicable)?
what_to_look_for: Table of dividends declared over last 3 years, OR a statement that no dividends have been declared.
common_violations: Dividend history missing — even nil declarations should be stated

title: Restated Financial Statements
description: Restated financial statements for the last 5 completed financial years (or since incorporation) must be included.
validation_question: Are restated financial statements for the last 5 years (or since incorporation) included?
what_to_look_for: Complete set of restated financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow) with auditor's examination report.
common_violations: Financial statements not restated or incomplete years provided

title: Auditor's Report/Examination Report
description: An independent auditor's examination report on the restated financial statements must be included.
validation_question: Is an independent auditor's report on the restated financials included?
what_to_look_for: A signed examination report by the statutory auditor covering the restated financial statements.
common_violations: Auditor's report missing or qualifications not disclosed

title: Balance Sheet Disclosure
description: A restated balance sheet showing assets, liabilities, and equity must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is a restated balance sheet with assets, liabilities, and equity disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Tabular balance sheet showing non-current assets, current assets, equity, non-current liabilities, and current liabilities.
common_violations: Balance sheet missing or not restated

title: Statement of Profit and Loss
description: A restated statement of profit and loss for the last 5 years must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is a restated Profit and Loss statement disclosed?
what_to_look_for: P&L statement showing revenue, expenses, EBITDA, PBT, PAT for multiple years.
common_violations: P&L statement missing or key line items not disclosed

title: Cash Flow Statement
description: A restated cash flow statement categorized by operating, investing, and financing activities must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is a restated cash flow statement disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Cash flow statement showing operating, investing, and financing activities with opening and closing cash balances.
common_violations: Cash flow statement missing or not categorized properly

title: Significant Accounting Policies
description: Significant accounting policies adopted by the company must be disclosed in the financial section.
validation_question: Are significant accounting policies disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Notes to financial statements covering revenue recognition, depreciation, inventory valuation, etc.
common_violations: Accounting policies not disclosed or incomplete

title: Financial Ratios and KPIs
description: Key financial ratios and performance indicators including CAGR, EBITDA margin, debt-equity ratio must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are key financial ratios and performance indicators disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Tables or sections showing CAGR, margins, leverage ratios, and return metrics.
common_violations: Key financial ratios not provided or trend analysis missing

title: Management Discussion and Analysis
description: A management discussion and analysis (MD&A) of financial condition and results of operations must be provided.
validation_question: Is a Management Discussion and Analysis of financial performance provided?
what_to_look_for: A section analyzing period-over-period changes in revenue, costs, and profitability with management commentary.
common_violations: MD&A section missing or lacks meaningful analysis

title: Outstanding Litigations Section Present
description: All outstanding litigations involving the issuer, promoters, directors, and group companies must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is an outstanding litigations section with complete disclosure provided?
what_to_look_for: Section listing all material pending litigations with case details, parties, amounts, and current status.
common_violations: Outstanding litigation section missing or material cases omitted

title: Materiality Threshold Defined
description: The materiality threshold for disclosure of litigations must be defined and approved by the Board.
validation_question: Is the materiality threshold for litigation disclosure defined?
what_to_look_for: A stated monetary threshold above which litigations are considered material for disclosure.
common_violations: Materiality threshold not defined or unreasonably high

title: Criminal Proceedings Disclosure
description: All criminal proceedings against the company, promoters, and directors must be disclosed regardless of materiality.
validation_question: Are all criminal proceedings against the company, promoters, and directors disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Section listing criminal cases OR a nil declaration confirming no criminal proceedings exist.
common_violations: Criminal proceedings by promoters/directors not disclosed

title: Tax Disputes Disclosure
description: All material tax disputes and demand notices from tax authorities must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are material tax disputes and demands disclosed?
what_to_look_for: List of pending tax disputes with assessment year, amount demanded, amount deposited, and current status.
common_violations: Tax disputes under-reported or demand amounts not specified

title: Regulatory Actions and Penalties
description: Any regulatory actions, penalties, or strictures by SEBI, stock exchanges, or other regulators must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are regulatory actions, penalties, or strictures disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Section disclosing any past regulatory actions OR a nil declaration.
common_violations: Past regulatory penalties not disclosed

title: General Information Section Present
description: The DRHP must contain a General Information section with details about the company, its directors, and key intermediaries.
validation_question: Does the DRHP contain a General Information section?
what_to_look_for: A section titled 'General Information' containing company overview, incorporation details, and intermediary information.
common_violations: General Information section missing

title: Bankers to the Company
description: Details of bankers to the company and bankers to the issue must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are the bankers to the company and bankers to the issue disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Names and addresses of all banks involved as bankers to the company and to the issue.
common_violations: Bank details incomplete

title: Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
description: The Company Secretary and Compliance Officer must be identified with contact details.
validation_question: Is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer identified?
what_to_look_for: Name, membership number, phone, email of the Company Secretary.
common_violations: Company Secretary contact details incomplete

title: Statutory Auditor Details
description: Details of the statutory auditor including firm name, ICAI registration number, and partner must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are the statutory auditor details disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Auditor firm name, ICAI registration number, and partner name and membership number.
common_violations: Auditor details incomplete or ICAI registration missing

title: Legal Advisors Details
description: Details of legal advisors to the company and the issue must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are the legal advisors to the company and issue disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Names and contact details of law firms acting as legal advisors.
common_violations: Legal advisor details missing

title: Definitions and Abbreviations Section
description: The DRHP must contain a Definitions and Abbreviations section explaining key terms used in the document.
validation_question: Is a Definitions and Abbreviations section present?
what_to_look_for: A section at the beginning defining key terms and abbreviations used throughout the DRHP.
common_violations: Definitions section missing or incomplete

title: Table of Contents Present
description: The DRHP must contain a Table of Contents with page numbers for all sections.
validation_question: Is a Table of Contents with page numbers present?
what_to_look_for: A Table of Contents page listing all major sections with corresponding page numbers.
common_violations: Table of Contents missing or page numbers incorrect

title: History and Corporate Structure
description: The history of the company including incorporation, key milestones, and corporate structure changes must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the corporate history and structure of the company disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Section covering incorporation date, key events, mergers/demergers, and corporate restructuring history.
common_violations: Corporate history section too brief or key events omitted

title: Subsidiaries and Associates
description: Details of all subsidiaries, associates, and joint ventures must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are all subsidiaries, associates, and joint ventures disclosed with details?
what_to_look_for: List of subsidiaries with CIN, percentage holding, nature of business, and financial summary.
common_violations: Subsidiary details incomplete or step-down subsidiaries not listed

title: Terms of the Offer
description: Complete terms and conditions of the offer including eligibility, lot size, and application process must be provided.
validation_question: Are the complete terms of the offer disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Section covering bid lot size, minimum/maximum application amounts, investor categories, and reservation details.
common_violations: Terms of offer incomplete or investor category allocations missing

title: Offer Structure and Reservations
description: The offer structure showing allocation among QIBs (≥75%), NIIs, and Retail (≥35%) must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the offer structure with category-wise allocation disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Table showing allocation percentages for QIBs, NIIs, and Retail investors per SEBI regulations.
common_violations: Category-wise allocation not disclosed or non-compliant with SEBI norms

title: Description of Equity Shares
description: Key terms of equity shares including rights, voting, transfer restrictions, and dividend entitlement must be described.
validation_question: Is a description of equity shares with key terms and rights provided?
what_to_look_for: Section describing shareholder rights, voting mechanisms, transfer restrictions, and dividend entitlements.
common_violations: Description of equity shares section missing

title: Restrictions on Foreign Ownership
description: Any restrictions on foreign ownership and investment in the company must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are restrictions on foreign ownership and investment disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Section describing FDI limits, FEMA compliance, and any sector-specific foreign ownership restrictions.
common_violations: Foreign ownership restrictions not addressed

title: Authority for the Offer
description: Board resolution and/or shareholders' resolution authorizing the offer must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the Board/shareholders' resolution authorizing the offer disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Resolution dates and details authorizing the Fresh Issue and/or Offer for Sale.
common_violations: Board resolution date or details not provided

title: SEBI Prohibition Check
description: The company, its promoters, and directors must not be prohibited from accessing the capital market by SEBI.
validation_question: Is there a confirmation that the company/promoters are not debarred from capital market access by SEBI?
what_to_look_for: Explicit confirmation that no promoter, director, or the company is prohibited by SEBI from accessing capital markets.
common_violations: SEBI non-debarment confirmation missing

title: Material Contracts and Agreements
description: All material contracts not entered in the ordinary course of business must be available for inspection.
validation_question: Are material contracts and documents for inspection listed?
what_to_look_for: List of material contracts with brief descriptions and inspection availability details.
common_violations: Material contracts list incomplete

title: Independent Directors Minimum Ratio
description: At least one-third of the board must be independent directors. If chairperson is executive or related to promoter, at least half must be independent.
validation_question: Does the board composition meet the minimum independent director requirements?
what_to_look_for: Board composition table showing at least 1/3 (or 1/2 if executive chair) are independent directors.
common_violations: Insufficient independent directors on the board

title: Woman Director on Board
description: The board must have at least one woman director.
validation_question: Does the board have at least one woman director?
what_to_look_for: At least one female name in the Board of Directors list.
common_violations: No woman director on the board

title: Board Meeting Frequency
description: The board must meet at least four times a year with a maximum gap of 120 days between meetings.
validation_question: Does the document disclose board meeting frequency (at least 4 per year)?
what_to_look_for: Statement about board meeting frequency and dates of recent board meetings.
common_violations: Board meeting frequency not disclosed or fewer than 4 meetings held

title: Whistle Blower / Vigil Mechanism
description: The company must have a vigil mechanism/whistle blower policy for directors and employees to report genuine concerns.
validation_question: Is a vigil mechanism / whistle blower policy disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Statement about the existence of a Board-approved vigil mechanism / whistle blower policy.
common_violations: Vigil mechanism not established or not disclosed

title: Code of Conduct for Directors
description: The company must have a code of conduct for its board members and senior management.
validation_question: Is a code of conduct for board members and senior management disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Reference to an adopted code of conduct applicable to directors and senior management.
common_violations: Code of conduct not mentioned

title: Insider Trading Code
description: The company must have a code of conduct to regulate insider trading as per SEBI PIT regulations.
required_elements: Code of Conduct for Prevention of Insider Trading
search_keywords: code for prevention of insider trading
validation_question: Has the company adopted an insider trading prevention code?
what_to_look_for: Reference to adoption of Code of Conduct per SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations.
common_violations: Insider trading code not mentioned or not adopted

title: Minimum Public Shareholding (25%)
description: Post-listing, at least 25% of the paid-up equity share capital must be held by the public (or 10% for large companies).
validation_question: Will the post-issue public shareholding meet the minimum 25% requirement?
what_to_look_for: Post-issue shareholding pattern showing public holding of at least 25%.
common_violations: Post-issue public shareholding below 25%

title: Promoter Holding Disclosure Pre and Post Issue
description: Detailed promoter shareholding before and after the issue must be disclosed.
validation_question: Is the promoter shareholding clearly disclosed for both pre-issue and post-issue scenarios?
what_to_look_for: Tables showing promoter/promoter group holdings with number of shares and percentages for pre-issue and post-issue.
common_violations: Post-issue promoter holding not clearly computed

title: Offer Summary / Issue Summary
description: An offer summary providing a snapshot of key offer terms must be provided.
validation_question: Is an offer summary with key terms provided?
what_to_look_for: A summary section or table showing key offer terms (size, price band, lot size, categories, timeline).
common_violations: Offer summary missing or incomplete

title: ASBA Mechanism Disclosure
description: The offer must clearly state that applications shall be through ASBA (Applications Supported by Blocked Amount) only.
validation_question: Is the ASBA mechanism for applications disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Clear statement that all applications must be through ASBA process with details of SCSBs.
common_violations: ASBA process details missing

title: Underwriting Agreement
description: Details of the underwriting agreement with the names of underwriters and their underwriting commitments must be disclosed.
validation_question: Are underwriting details including underwriter names and commitments disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Table showing underwriter names and their respective underwriting commitments in shares and amounts.
common_violations: Underwriting commitments not disclosed or incomplete

title: ISIN Number Disclosure
description: The International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) must be disclosed for the equity shares.
validation_question: Is the ISIN for the equity shares disclosed?
what_to_look_for: A 12-character ISIN code starting with 'INE' on the cover page or general information section.
common_violations: ISIN missing or incorrect format

title: Stock Exchange Listing Details
description: The stock exchanges where listing is proposed must be identified with in-principle approval status.
validation_question: Are the stock exchanges for proposed listing identified?
what_to_look_for: Statement identifying BSE and/or NSE as the listing exchanges with in-principle approval confirmation.
common_violations: Listing exchange not specified or in-principle approval not obtained

title: Dematerialization Details
description: The offer shares shall be in dematerialized form only, and the depositories (NSDL/CDSL) must be identified.
validation_question: Are dematerialization details and depository names disclosed?
what_to_look_for: Statement that shares will be in demat form with NSDL/CDSL as depositories and depository participant details.
common_violations: Depository details missing

title: IPO Grading Disclosure (if applicable)
description: If the IPO has been graded by a credit rating agency, the grading must be disclosed.
validation_question: If IPO grading has been obtained, is it disclosed?
what_to_look_for: IPO grading score from a SEBI-registered credit rating agency, or a statement that grading was not obtained.
common_violations: IPO grading obtained but not disclosed

title: Expert Opinions and Consents
description: Consents of directors, auditors, BRLMs, legal advisors, and other experts must be obtained and available for inspection.
validation_question: Are expert consents and opinions disclosed as available for inspection?
what_to_look_for: Statement confirming that written consents from all experts have been obtained.
common_violations: Expert consent details missing
